deadline.value: For October 2027 entry the next deadline is 1 June 2027 for overseas students and 25 August 2027 for home students.
deadline.quote: The next application deadline for studies commencing in October 2027 is 01 June 2027 for Overseas students and 25 August 2027 for Home students.

gre_subject.value: King's does not consider the GRE in its selection processes, so no GRE Subject test is used.
gre_subject.quote: Please note that at King's we do not consider the GRE in our selection processes.

supervisor.value: Written agreement from a supervisor is needed before the application can go forward.
supervisor.quote: You must receive written confirmation that your supervisor(s) have agreed to submit you before progressing with your application.

also.quote: Potential applicants can identify and contact appropriate supervisors proposing projects

funding.value: All scholarships and awards are competitive; some cover both stipend and fees, others fees only.
funding.quote: All scholarships, bursaries or other awards are offered on a competitive basis.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree with 2:1 honours in an engineering discipline or a closely related subject; a 2:2 only with a Masters with Merit or above.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should have a bachelors degree with 2:1 honours degree in an Engineering discipline or a closely related subject

notes: One engineering PhD covers the department's research themes. The page names no sub-discipline, so the also_fields are inferred from the umbrella title and should be checked. Biomedical engineering is a separate record.
